title: Limited service state over non-3GPP access

entities.name: Limited service state over non-3GPP access
entities.description: State where UE is unable to obtain normal service from a PLMN over non-3GPP access due to various conditions like invalid USIM, illegal UE, or network restrictions.

entities.name: No USIM in the ME
entities.description: Condition where no USIM is present in the Mobile Equipment, triggering limited service state.

entities.name: Illegal UE or illegal ME
entities.description: Condition where UE or ME is declared illegal during registration, de-registration, or service request, making any USIM invalid.

entities.name: 5GS services not allowed
entities.description: Condition received during registration, de-registration, or service request indicating 5GS services are not permitted.

entities.name: PLMN not allowed
entities.description: Condition received during registration, de-registration, or service request indicating the PLMN is not allowed.

entities.name: Tracking area not allowed
entities.description: Condition received during registration, de-registration, or service request indicating the tracking area is not allowed.

entities.name: Roaming not allowed in this tracking area
entities.description: Condition received during registration, de-registration, or service request indicating roaming is not permitted in the tracking area.

entities.name: Serving network not authorized
entities.description: Condition received during registration or service request indicating the serving network is not authorized.

entities.name: Initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: Procedure allowing UE to perform initial registration for emergency services even in limited service state, using the PLMN of the current N3IWF or TNGF.

entities.name: Network selection
entities.description: Procedure performed in limited service state with a valid USIM, as defined in TS 24.502.

relations.description: Absence of USIM triggers entry into limited service state.
Illegal UE or ME condition triggers entry into limited service state.
5GS services not allowed condition triggers entry into limited service state.
PLMN not allowed condition triggers entry into limited service state.
Tracking area not allowed condition triggers entry into limited service state.
Roaming not allowed in tracking area condition triggers entry into limited service state.
Serving network not authorized condition triggers entry into limited service state.
Limited service state allows emergency registration as an exception.
Network selection is performed in limited service state with a valid USIM.
